stage: initial dev complete; four initial validation arms complete
decision: No initial policy demonstrated a valid all-domain promotion. RAG raises source visibility, but full skill hurts tools; program JSON execution fails on missing answer binding. State repair improves coding on dev. Self-revision increases output tokens and lowers primary macro.
statistics: development observations only; final CIs pending

hypothesis: Contract routing preserves bare native tools while retaining skill/RAG and executable coding feedback; a one-number Python stdout interface removes the failed dual JSON/variable contract for arithmetic.
selection_rule: same preregistered validation promotion gate; no final-test access
warning: Routed combines dev-selected components; stdout is its single math-interface intervention. Neither is proven yet.

decision: Promote routed over bare: validation macro 52.60→67.71; every primary domain non-regressing and retention 29.85→38.81. Reject stdout: 61.46 macro, math 50.0 versus routed 70.83; simplifying the interface alone did not fix program-generation/modeling errors.
statistics: single-seed validation, paired CI recorded separately; final test still sealed

hypothesis: Change only tool serialization to schema-explicit JSON with thinking; separately ask reading answers to copy exact source spans to preserve names/units. Both are compared with routed.
selection_rule: unchanged validation gate; no final-test access

decision: Neither policy passes the gate. tool_json validation tool accuracy falls 97.92→75.0. literal macro rises 67.71→68.75, but arithmetic falls 70.83→66.67, exceeding the 3 pp guard despite unchanged arithmetic prompts. Keep routed provisionally.
runtime_observation: BF16 batched inference changes some sampled outputs when other requests change. Do not attribute unchanged-contract score changes to the modified component.

hypothesis: Focus changes only the reading source count from literal: top 4→top 1. Knowledge adds full-corpus lexical retrieval for choice questions; no QA labels and no larger model.
selection_rule: Use three-seed validation for routed/literal/focus/knowledge to reduce selection driven by one-seed serving variation; preserve the same +1 pp and regression gates. Search stops at 18 policies regardless of final outcome.

stopping_reason: Declared 18-policy search budget exhausted; local budget stopping, not global optimality.
